summary: The change adds an optional `account` hint to control-plane connection cards. The hint flows through the workspace server and control plane to Google's `login_hint` and `prompt=select_account`, and the card and setup page show it. The change also stops sending the "default" placeholder name so that unnamed cards add a connection. It is not ready: the durable workspace suite fails because of the placeholder change, the string-equality mapping of the placeholder also catches explicitly named "default" connections, and several changed lines have no tests.

findings.body: The durable run fails in "released protocol 25 clients can connect new and saved integration cards". ConnectionService now converts the `default` placeholder to `connectionName: undefined`, but this test still expects `{ integration: "example", connectionName: "default" }` to reach `startSetup`. Change the expectation to match the new contract: an unnamed released-client card must start setup without a connection name, so it adds a connection and does not reconnect `default`. The suite must pass.

Comparing the request's `connectionName` to the string "default" cannot tell the compatibility placeholder from a name that was actually given. `connectionInput` in ToolRuntime.ts:1083-1087 copies `oauth.start({ name })` directly into `connectionName`. So when the agent calls `oauth.start({ name: "default", ... })` to reconnect an existing connection named `default`, the call now silently creates a new randomly named connection, and the broken `default` connection is left in place. Released clients have already created connections named `default` through unnamed cards, and those connections can no longer be reconnected. Mark the placeholder explicitly instead of relying on the string. For example, set `newConnection: true` on the compatibility object in `collectConnectionRequest` (the legacy schema already allows `newConnection`) and drop the name only when that marker is present.

testRequests.target: packages/web/src/IntegrationSetupPage.tsx:98-103 — the account hint appears when `data.account` is set and status is not "ready", and does not appear when status is "ready" or `account` is absent
testRequests.rationale: No test loads this file, so all six changed lines are uncovered.

testRequests.target: packages/workspace-server/src/agent/runtime/ToolRuntime.ts:221-232 and :505 — showConnectionCard with `account` collects a request that carries the account; two cards for the same integration with the same account are deduplicated; cards with different accounts stay separate
testRequests.rationale: The coverage report lists these lines as uncovered. The durable server test runs out of process and never checks deduplication of identical account cards.

testRequests.target: apps/control-plane/src/integrations/IntegrationService.ts:641-645 — the authorization URL for a Google setup started with `account` contains `login_hint=<account>` and `prompt=select_account consent`
testRequests.rationale: The tests check `withAccountChoice` alone but not that IntegrationService passes the stored `setup.account` into it. Nothing checks the startSetup → authorize wiring.
This added line is a type-only annotation. Mark it coverage-exempt with that reason, or cover it, so that the coverage gate passes.
